name: Chaser Pro

origin.basis: Shandong Jiluer Tire Co., Tengzhou, Shandong (brand directory).

manufacturing.basis: The listing does not state the factory.

positioning: Light folding race clincher from a Shandong tire maker, sold in China as a low-cost alternative to premium race tires.
weight_basis: One owner weighed a 28C at 216 g.

community.summary: Light at 216 g (28C) for CNY 140; note the reversed rotation arrow.
Three bulges and wide separation of rubber from the casing after about 2,400 km; a commenter's tire was fine at over 6,000 km.
Owner, 1,300 km: good dry grip and stable braking on a 17% descent, one nail puncture, easy to fit; no wet verdict because the owner rode cautiously in the rain.
Owner-measured 205-209 g at 28C and about 30 mm wide at 95 psi on a 19 mm rim; commenters say the crown is thin and weights vary.
Commenters on a first-look post: thin and puncture-prone for some, several large cracks after a few hundred kilometres for one, and half a year without problems for another.

availability.note: Sold by Taobao shops in mainland China; no official JILUER store was found.

price_observations.conditions: Taobao/Tmall shop list price on 2026-11-01; shipping within mainland China. The listing does not say whether an option is one tire or a pair.

caveats: One owner reports bulging and ply separation; inspect the casing regularly.

An owner of a 25C JILUER Chaser-family tire called it a dry-weather tire and advised against rain and descents; the post does not show whether it is the Pro, so it is not counted as wet evidence. No lab test found.
The listings do not say whether a price is for one tire or a pair.
